thread:
amelia: Quick poll — someone left two s'mores in the meeting room fridge. Are we allowed to microwave them or should we honor them as cold artifacts? 🤔
jordan: Microwave = immediate melty chaos. I'd toast in the toaster oven for 20–30s. :+1:
lee: Toaster oven = crumbs on the tray. Also fire hazard if someone forgets. 🙃
sam: Cold s'mores are a vibe. 0/10 would microwave. 😂
priya: Can we do the "cup + candle" desktop roast? low-tech marshmallow revival. 🔥🕯️
amelia: ok new option: assemble and heat for 10s in microwave to warm but not soggy. science?
jordan: 10s might just melt the chocolate and leave marshmallow chewy. If you want chewy, go 12–15s.
lee: @jordan you're scaring me. Also who labeled them "office property"? :stuck_out_tongue:
sam: Proposal: whoever left them gets first dibs. If unclaimed, community s'more night. :tada:
kitchen-bot: Reminder: microwave door sensors checked 3 days ago. Please don't leave food unattended. 🛎️
priya: Also kudos to whoever packed them — bravery points. 👏
amelia: Vote with emoji: :one: microwave 10s, :two: toaster 25s, :three: cold forever. I'll eat whatever. Poll open for 30m.
jordan: :one: (leaning)
sam: :three:
lee: :two:
priya: :one:
amelia: Poll tally so far — 3 votes for microwave-ish, 1 toaster, 1 cold. We'll wait 30m then microwave for 10s unless owner shows. Peacekeeper policy enacted. 😇
